method: Direct integer Boolean MS WRITE, separately complete fresh DEVICE baselines, strict target/partner readback, own fresh whole-state restoration and sole END ACK. Linked watches are before END; mono observations follow END on the same Control connection without exclusive ownership.
scope: Warm linked 0-to-1 directly on every input; freshly established linked 1-to-0 and fresh unlinked 0-to-1 via inputs 13/14. No cold-start, other-channel mono/reverse, long-term, raw-link/raw-pan preservation, audio-decoding or acoustic-safety qualification. DEVICE windows describe observed projections, not atomic snapshots.
observation_limits: Mono: writer budget 87 seconds within the unchanged 90-second backend lease; 24-second passive watch plus one full final read after END, nonexclusive observer budget 40 seconds, same Control socket, no second BEGIN or reconnect. Another owner, drift or incomplete read fails the observation; no ownership guarantee after END. Earlier linked-forward records do not store numeric capture times.
